text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My vision is spinning...—
My legs feel light, or maybe heavy... and on top of that.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Right there! Keep going,
××××××××!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"No good, her eyes have been stolen away...
...I have to win them back, immediately."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Right this second—!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —...gh, *cough, hack*!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...
Aston Machan gazed aimlessly up at the buzzing stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"XXXXXXXX,
thank you for the best race ever!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"XXXXXXX~!
I'll come watch your next race too!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Wait...
From where I stood, I couldn't see her expression.

On the way back, Aston Machan
was gazing out the window, looking unusually lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
......
We didn't get interviewed, did we?

Aston Machan's unique pitch-running style, vigorously clawing at the dirt, is in fine form.
Today's race was magnificent as well.

"It is customary for an Umamusume who runs well in a GⅠ race to hold a press scrum.
And so, we were waiting for the press corps after the race today, but—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, just a quick word, please!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Over here as well!
How did you feel about this race—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Um, over here.
Machan, over here~.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I'm right here...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I thought I ran a good race, though.
Does this mean I still have a long way to go?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whether on the blog, during interviews,
or even from the stands, no one was looking at Chan at all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I feel like I'm wilting.

Under normal circumstances, this would be an unthinkable situation.
...That said, it was merely customary, not an obligation.
choice_data_list: (Can something like this even happen...? No—)

text_block_list.text:
—Overthinking won't give any answers.
For now, let's just reset our mindset...
Just as I turn to say that—
—There was no one there.

I quickly spun around in the other direction.
A young man I'd never seen before was standing there.

I look across the seats, at the doors, and into the next carriage,
but there are only unfamiliar faces standing there—
Only she had vanished into thin air.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Is something the matter?
Are you hot? You're sweating...

I hurriedly wiped my brow.
Was I daydreaming or something?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right? Has spring
turned against you as well, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's go see the cherry blossoms on the way back.
We shall hold Part 2 of our 'Befriending Spring' gathering.

Stopping by the row of cherry blossoms in the central plaza,
many Umamusume were pausing to look up and take photos,
as if they were in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...The cherry blossoms really are incredible.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because it is so beautiful and fleeting, 
the moment it scatters becomes a treasured memory.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Machan must follow that example too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Next time must be flashy, lovelier than anyone else.
Otherwise, nobody will remember me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, let's make our
next race the Sprinters Stakes."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just like last year,
I'll put on a show so amazing
it'll make Trainer-san cry.

The next target is the Sprinters Stakes.
We must receive the same thunderous applause as last year, once again.

—Incidentally, I went to the hospital for an examination a few days later...
Just as expected, they found no abnormalities.
